Cleaver (Butcher).Effect: A cleaver not intended for combat. Deals normal Damage, but does not apply the weapon effect.
Cleaver (Butcher).Name: Cleaver (Butcher)

Knife.Effect: A knife not intended for combat. Deals normal Damage, but does not apply the weapon effect.
Knife.Name: Knife

Sickle (Peasant).Effect: A sickle not intended for combat. Deals 1 less Damage than a combat Sickle.
Sickle (Peasant).Name: Sickle (Peasant)

Spear (rudimentary).Effect: A simple spear, that deals 1 less Damage than a normal spear.
Spear (rudimentary).Name: Spear (rudimentary)

Pike (rudimentary).Effect: A simple pike, that deals 1 less Damage than a normal pike.
Pike (rudimentary).Name: Pike (rudimentary)

Pitchfork.Effect: A pitchfork not intended for combat. Deals normal Damage, but does not apply the weapon effect.
Pitchfork.Name: Pitchfork

Scythe (peasant).Effect: A scythe for peasant work, not intended for combat. Can not do the special weapon effect.
Scythe (peasant).Name: Scythe (peasant)

Staff.Effect: A simple staff not intended for combat. Deals normal Quarterstaff Damage, but the weapon effect is not applied.
Staff.Name: Staff

Stat Retraining.Effect: Pay a coach to train you, and inter-swap 2 Stats on your Hero Sheet (only doable between Adventures).
Stat Retraining.Name: Stat Retraining

Feat Untraining.Effect: Pay a specialist in your Class or Race to untrain you in a Feat, removing everything gained through it and gaining back the cost (only doable between Adventures). Does not work for Afflictions.
Feat Untraining.Name: Feat Untraining

Specialization Retraining.Effect: Pay a trainer of your Class to change your Class's Specialization (only doable between Adventures).
Specialization Retraining.Name: Specialization Retraining

Language Course.Effect: Pay a teacher to teach you how to speak one language (only doable between Adventures).
Language Course.Name: Language Course

Skill Development Classes.Effect: Pay a teacher to teach you how to become Skilled in a non-combat Skill (only doable between Adventures).
Skill Development Classes.Name: Skill Development Classes

Torch.Effect: Shines light in a 5 meter radius. Lasts for 1 Encounter.
Torch.Name: Torch

Ball Bearings (bag).Effect: 2x1 meter area becomes difficult terrain (1-time use)
Ball Bearings (bag).Name: Ball Bearings (bag)

Caltrops (set).Effect:
Use on a 1x1 meter area. A unit stepping on them takes 1 Pierce Damage.
They break after someone steps on them
Deals double Damage (2) if it pierces flesh directly.
Caltrops (set).Name: Caltrops (set)

Explosive Barrel.Effect: When hit with Fire or Shock Damage (or other way to ignite it), explodes, hitting all Units within 1 meter for 4d6 Fire Damage.
Explosive Barrel.Name: Explosive Barrel

First Aid Kit.Effect:
On a successful Focus Grade 8 check, stabilizes an unconscious character.
One time use.
First Aid Kit.Name: First Aid Kit

Hunting Trap.Effect:
When stepping on it, Instinct Check (Grade 10) or 1d6 Damage and Root.
Takes 1 minute to Rearm
Hunting Trap.Name: Hunting Trap
Hunting Trap.Notes: A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.

Paint Pellet.Effect: Can be thrown at a Unit within 3 meters (with a 1 {A}Action Point). That Unit does not benefit from Cover and you can see it if it turns invisible. It still benefits from Hard Cover normally.
Paint Pellet.Name: Paint Pellet

Craft Custom Gear.Effect: Pay a craftsman to craft a custom version of a weapon or armor. It costs its original price, plus 50 {Gold}Gold.
Craft Custom Gear.Name: Craft Custom Gear

Craft Gear With 1 Magic Component.Effect: Pay a craftsman to craft a custom version weapon or armor, with 1 additional Magic Component you provide. It costs its original price, plus 200 {Gold}Gold.
Craft Gear With 1 Magic Component.Name: Craft Gear With 1 Magic Component

Craft Gear With 2 Magic Components.Effect: Pay a craftsman to craft a custom version weapon or armor, with 2 additional Magic Components you provide. It costs its original price, plus 200 {Gold}Gold.
Craft Gear With 2 Magic Components.Name: Craft Gear With 2 Magic Components

Craft Gear With 3 Magic Components.Effect: Pay a craftsman to craft a custom version weapon or armor, with 3 additional Magic Components you provide. It costs its original price, plus 200 {Gold}Gold.
Craft Gear With 3 Magic Components.Name: Craft Gear With 3 Magic Components

Craft Gear With 4 Magic Components.Effect: Pay a craftsman to craft a custom version weapon or armor, with 4 additional Magic Components you provide. It costs its original price, plus 200 {Gold}Gold.
Craft Gear With 4 Magic Components.Name: Craft Gear With 4 Magic Components

Dust of Appearance.Effect:
Throw in a 3x3 area. Glows on magical objects and magical traps. Units with the dust on them can't be invisible.
Also breaks illusions, puts out fire and removes toxic gas and acid puddles.
Dust of Appearance.Name: Dust of Appearance

Holy Water Vial (100ml).Effect: Deals 1d8 Damage to an Unholy Unit upon 100ml being splashed on it (3 meters range).
Holy Water Vial (100ml).Name: Holy Water Vial (100ml)

Consumable (Standard).Effect:
Refers to items like Potion of Healing, Fire Oil, etc.
These might be available in short supply, so check with your QM.

Refers to items like Potion of Greater Healing, Tomes, etc.

Magic Trinket (Standard).Effect:
Refers to items like Ring of Health, Boots of Initiative, etc.

Refers to items like Ring of Instinct, Weapons +1, etc.

Acid (vial, 100ml).Effect: Can be thrown with Improvised Attack for the extra 1d6 Acid Damage to the main target and all other Units within 1 meter.
